description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller named PermissionController, which handles HTTP requests related to permissions management in an admin web interface. It includes methods for displaying the permissions page and paginating permissions data, wired with permission services and security annotations.

classes.name: PermissionController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing user permissions in the admin interface.

methods.name: displayPermissions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the permissions page, currently throws 'Not implemented' exception.

methods.name: pagePermissions
methods.description: Handles POST requests to retrieve a paginated list of permissions in JSON format.
